biography_summary: 弗朗索瓦·波里耶（Francois Lionel Poirier），现年59岁，加拿大籍能源企业高管，现任TC Energy（加拿大TC能源公司）总裁兼首席执行官。Poirier拥有渥太华大学运筹学学士学位（以优等成绩毕业）和约克大学舒立克商学院工商管理硕士学位（以优异成绩毕业），并完成多伦多大学公司董事教育项目。加入TC Energy之前，Poirier在投资银行领域拥有25年从业经验，曾在摩根大通证券（JPMorgan Securities）纽约办公室任职17年，担任电力与管道投资银行部集团负责人，随后创建并担任富国银行证券加拿大公司（Wells Fargo Securities Canada）总裁。2014年加入TC Energy担任Energy East管道项目总裁，此后历任高级副总裁、执行副总裁（战略与企业开发）、首席运营官等要职。2016年主导完成对Columbia Pipeline Group约130亿美元的收购。2021年1月升任总裁兼CEO后，Poirier成功推动了液体管道业务分拆为South Bow Corporation（2024年10月）、Coastal GasLink管道商业运营（2025年）和Southeast Gateway管道投用（2025年）等重大项目。他还倡导"Build Canada Now"倡议，推动加拿大能源监管改革和基础设施建设。2024年起担任加拿大帝国商业银行（CIBC）董事，2026年被加拿大商会评为年度商业领袖。

collection_meta.notes: Profile of Francois Lionel Poirier, President & CEO of TC Energy. Age 59 (per TC Energy official bio), nationality Canadian. Full name: Francois Lionel Poirier (confirmed from insidertrades.com). Education: BSc Operations Research (Magna Cum Laude) from University of Ottawa; MBA (with distinction) from Schulich School of Business, York University; ICD.D from Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto (2007-2008). Career: 17 years at JPMorgan Securities (Group Head, Power & Pipelines IB), then founding President of Wells Fargo Securities Canada. Joined TC Energy in 2014 as President, Energy East Pipeline. Held progressive roles: SVP Strategy & Corporate Development (2015), EVP Strategy & Corporate Development (2017), EVP + President Power & Storage and Mexico (2019), COO (2020), CEO (Jan 2021). Led $13B Columbia Pipeline Group acquisition (2016). Oversaw South Bow spinoff (Oct 2024). Board member of CIBC (since 2024), Business Council of Canada, American Petroleum Institute. Named 2026 Canadian Business Leader of the Year by Canadian Chamber of Commerce. Community service: former Chair of North York Harvest Food Bank, Co-Chair of Special Olympics Canada Winter Games Calgary 2024. Estimated net worth ~$8M based on TC Energy stock holdings (119,064 shares). No Wikipedia page. No Wikidata QID. Birth date estimated from age 59. No family members found in public sources.
